Production copy helper releases monitor while paused; concurrent outside edit acquires monitor and rejects resume before save staging. diagnostic.scope: 262144 whole-cell history entries; no competing threads, server, geometry, save, network, rendering or system qualification. Three warmups, 20 measured runs, clone first. Guarded timings include monitor entry and timer overhead; batch totals include rebuilding index outside monitor. Exact replay order and source independence checked outside timing. Thread allocation is not peak memory.

tradeoffs: Higher total CPU and allocation from rebuilding index and keys. Per-batch bounded work is not a wall-clock bound: GC, scheduling, final engine validation, tail serialization and fsync still need qualification. Busy-world retries retain existing conservative staging policy. No geometry/persistence/admission cap raised.
